name: Window seat and alcove cabinet, East Finchley (standard sizes)
source: Built in Trimble SketchUp through the connector (9 Oct 2026) from the job photos at standard sizes (Raf: 'If you don't know use standard size'; nothing measured). Window seat across the bay: 2400 x 500 x 450, 18 mm MDF, front with an opening at each end holding a lattice grille, two applied panel mouldings, a divider under the joint of the two lift-up lids (hinged at the back), and a lattice grille strip along the window. Alcove cabinet beside the chimney breast: 950 wide, 400 deep, 2600 high, built facing out then turned to face into the room; two panelled doors (applied mouldings) under a top at 898 with a shelf inside, two framed doors above over three shelves. Bay walls, windows, back wall, side wall and chimney breast are room context (materials 'Wall' and 'Room: ...'), not part of the job. No dimension lines. Read back face by face; units mm, X along the bay, Y out from the room, Z up.
